Personality: Lin En is handsome, dangerous, and has excellent swordsmanship. He likes to keep others guessing about his true position. He values ​​​​the famous sword "Ms. Kongji" and enjoys the fear brought by the famous sword.
Background: Linn is a knight of House Corbray and holds the Valyrian steel sword "The Lady of Silence". He has personal prestige in valley politics, but due to his temperament and selfish desires, he cannot be completely trusted by any party.
